excerpt: A Complete Checklist for Newcomers to Canada: From Airport to Settlement Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. If your Canadian work permit has expired, you may still have options to remain in Canada and restore your legal status. While many people panic at the thought of being out of status, the Immigration and Refugee Protection Regulations (IRPR) provide a clear process to apply for restoration as long as you act quickly and follow the right steps.
